thread:
alicia: quick heads-up: zephyr-int8-v3 canary (streaming) is showing a bump in funcall parse failures. ~1.4% on last 1.5k streaming calls.

Tom: any examples? truncated JSON or weird punctuation?

alicia: mostly suffix truncation and occasional stray commas near array ends. sample:
```
{"action":"update_user","params":{"id":1234,"prefs":["email","sms",]}
# stream cut here
```

susan: that pattern suggests chunk boundary cutting inside a multibyte token or tokenization misalign after quant kernels.

samir: is this replicated on batch (non-streaming)?

alicia: batch-mode int8 is ~0.18%. fp16 streaming baseline is 0.04%. so streaming+int8 seems amplified.

Tom: short-term mitigations: 1) json-sentinel assembler that buffers until a syntactic close or TTL (we can start with 120ms); 2) disable auto-retry-on-parse-fail for canary to avoid duplicate tool calls; 3) mirror live streaming to fp16 for diffing.

susan: I'll add per-chunk SHA256, chunk_len, and token_index metadata to the harness so we can diff streams token-by-token. if checksums diverge before transport, it's generation-level.

alicia: quick repro I ran locally:
```python
from redwood_client import Client
c = Client(model="zephyr-int8-v3", stream=True, temp=0.0)
for p in load_prompts('toolcall-heavy-json'):
    out = c.generate(p)
    save_raw_chunks(out.chunks)
```

samir: scheduling a 5k canary run: canary/zephyr-int8-v3/1733334444. infra-bot will post results. also starting a tiny quant-grid: last-8..last-1 mixed-precision rollback to localize layer causing divergence.

infra-bot: canary job queued: /ci/canary/1733334444-run1. mirror job queued: mirror/zephyr-int8-v3->fp16/1733334444.

Tom: operational plan draft:
- pause streaming rollout for zephyr-int8-v3 until triage (set routing to buffered fallback).
- run canary + mirror 5k. collect parse_failure_rate, dup_tool_invokes, median latency, checksum-divergence-index.
- if streaming parse_failure_rate > 0.5% and +delta vs buffered > 0.3pp, keep streaming disabled and escalate.
- implement assembler TTL=120ms and no-retry flag as short-term mitigation.

alicia: filed INF-3700 and assigned to @samir and @susan. will update when infra-bot posts report. :white_check_mark:
